method.statistic: Median of 36 per-process batch means per variant; four independent processes, not 36 independent populations
method.timingInstrumentation: No coverage, GC forcing, or async hooks in timing runs
method.host: One workstation; background desktop workload uncontrolled; tests and builds excluded during timing
method.scope: Framework microbenchmarks only; no React or end-to-end throughput inference

allocations.note: Separate diagnostic processes. Heap probes retain 20000 collections with forced GC; first sample is warmup. Promise counts include identical harness plumbing.
